scope: Six previously unlinked manual requirements now reference inspected existing case implementations; full requirement completion is not claimed.

PAT-SCALE-RELATIVE.remaining: Signed and extreme degrees, all ten scales and selected root/degree/rotation interactions; all channel assignments and full discrete harmony domains remain.

SCALE-PRECEDENCE.remaining: Channel/global lifetime and highest-slot override/clear tested; staggered coprime rate/length timelines and every lock slot remain.

OPT-MASK-SNAP.remaining: All ten scales at C and D roots, snap off/on restoration and degree/rotation independence; remaining roots, pitch boundaries and interacting masks remain.

OPT-MASK-QUANTISE.remaining: Global/channel/step Off/On/X precedence and clearing under degree/rotation tested; other harmony domains and combinations remain.

OPT-PENTATONIC-MERGED.remaining: All ten pentatonic selections and numeric merge modes plus selected harmony restoration; all-pentatonic interaction, single-source and priority combinations remain.

MERGE-CONTROL.remaining: Repeated velocity and shifted-length mode cycles tested; full trig/note cross-mode isolation and K1 release-order matrix remain.
